title: RBI Lead Bank Scheme (60% CD Ratio) & Mis-Selling Conduct Directions
summary: RBI revised Lead Bank Scheme guidelines (introduced 1969) to strengthen SLBCs and LDMs with minimum 60% CD ratio in rural/semi-urban branches.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Financial Inclusion & Customer Conduct. Enforces 60% rural CD ratio and establishes first formal mis-selling definition.
